questions.question:
Which two numbers(not digits), from the given options, should be interchanged to make the given equation correct?

(200 − 6) ÷ 14 × 2 − 8 = 24 ÷ 4 × 25 ÷ 5

Three statements are given, followed by three conclusions numbered I, II and III. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

All bags are sticks.

All trees are papers.

Some sticks are papers.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some sticks are trees.

II. Some papers are trees.

III. No bags are papers

options.text: Only conclusions I and III follow

questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statement is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1eba17cdfef9699b33a71e371a82b3bcdf1e4c0adcf89a320b91831a1cbb2c33.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some sticks are trees → **Does not** Follow (As, No definite relation given between sticks and trees, So, it can be possible but not definitely true)

II. Some papers are trees → Follow (As, all trees are papers. So, whole trees comes in papers therefore some papers are trees is definitely true)

III. No bags are papers → Does not Follow (As, No definite relation given between bags and papers, So, it can be possible but not definitely true)

So, Only conclusion II follows.

Hence, the correct answer is "**Only conclusion II follows**".

questions.question:
Select the option that is related to the third word in the same way as the second word is related to the first word.

(The words must be considered as meaningful English words and must not be related to each other based on the number of letters/number of consonants/vowels in the word)

Up : Down :: Backward : ?
questions.solution:
**Logic :** Term : Antonym

So,

__
 
• Antonym of **up** is **down**.

Similarly,

 
• Antonym of **backward** is **forward**.

Hence, **"****Forward"** is the correct answer.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Forward → It is antonym of backward or reverse.
 
• Straighten → It is antonym of bend or curve
 
• Lift → It is antonym of lower or drop.
 
• Low → It is antonym of high.

questions.question:
‘A + B’ means ‘A is the brother of B’

‘A – B’ means ‘A is the wife of B’

‘A × B’ means ‘A is the son of B’

‘A ÷ B’ means ‘A is the husband of B’

If P + Q – S + R × L ÷ M, then which of the following statements is correct?

options.text: Q is the sister of M.
L is the father of P
P is the brother of S.

questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/94f0af2bd93b93688d2c6092e652fb2d84f74342de195154154b4e73abc5a0da.png] 

Given :

 
 

 
 
A is

 
 
 

 
 
Symbol

 
 
 
+

 
 
 
-

 
 
 
×

 
 ÷
 
 

 
 
Meaning

 
 
 
Brother

 
 
 
Wife

 
 
 
Son

 
 Husband
 
 

 
 
to B

 
 
 

Statement given : P + Q – S + R × L ÷ M

So,

 
• P + Q → P is the brother of Q.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fe3327ec6621be4a7c0274e96152a3613207c0c1bd78e63c5d99620dad86bd08.png] 

 
• Q – S → Q is the wife of S.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f19d144194338b965eadef14bd257f1780354a157a6b1a983bdd36ffd19c93cc.png] 

 
• S + R → S is the brother of R.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/32dc722c2c28283ef31d58f99072154f63989c1a31e3583be0420208c93e2ae8.png] 

 
• R × L → R is the son of L.

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5adeafddb55154cbc94bd0cd3a5a4983f0e4ede154f1ee5ec7f15598c6d408b9.png] 

 
• L ÷ M → L is the husband of M. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c8ee1be60507926cd33fbdf7a1c11f3fe993e0f49551af43b7f5ad5c499fd55d.png] 

 

Thus, according to the final family tree :

 
• Option - (1) : Q is the sister of M → This statement is incorrect as Q is daughter-in-law of M.
 
• Option - (2) : **P is S’s wife’s brother** → **This statement is correct.**
 
• Option - (3) : L is the father of P → This statement is incorrect as L is the father-in-law of P's sister Q.
 
• Option - (4) : P is the brother of S → This statement is incorrect as P is the brother-in-law of S.

Hence, "**Option - (2)**" is the correct answer.

questions.question: Six students are sitting around a circular table facing the centre. Sam is sitting second to the right of Krish. Vishal is sitting second to the right of Sam. Savio is sitting third to the right of Sam. Michelle is the immediate neighbour of Sam and Krish. Dixon is sitting third to the right of Krish. Who is sitting between Vishal and Krish?
questions.solution:
**Given :** Six students are sitting around a circular table facing the centre.

**Explanation :**

1) Sam is sitting second to the right of Krish.

2) Vishal is sitting second to the right of Sam.

3) Savio is sitting third to the right of Sam.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/60a4ae6893c86243e1f283e8a709f80ebed323fd8972377bdabb2c25eb501e0a.png] 

4) Michelle is the immediate neighbour of Sam and Krish.

5) Dixon is sitting third to the right of Krish.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f1d868a6a1e03f259436972b50e8e8598f49f59f4be1fbdfd29d484538e30d70.png] 

Thus, according to the final arrangement Savio is sitting between Vishal and Krish.

Hence, **"Savio"** is the correct answer.

questions.question: Six boys M, G, V, A, R and D are standing in a straight line facing towards North. Only three boys are standing to the left of G. M is standing at the second position from the left end. Only D is standing between G and A. Who is standing at the second position from the extreme right end?
questions.solution:
**Given :** Six boys M, G, V, A, R and D are standing in a straight line facing towards North.

**Explanation : **

1) Only three boys are standing to the left of G.

2) M is standing at the second position from the left end.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ab3241983a2514ad71ff708ead3e870b5a952381098d08e3e1c4cf955df1e62a.png] 

3) Only D is standing between G and A.

As position of V and R are not known yet, therefore there are two possible positions for V and R. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/aae93486b6e8d6c0617a7c4ed84d4e90965cf1d419f737751a649122a9e90d17.png] 

Thus, according to the final arrangement 'D' is standing at the second position from the extreme right end.

Hence, **"D"** is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Three different positions of the same dice are shown. Find the number on the face opposite the face having '2'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/dd56e96427d6488dddf8da8eebd88181a847538a01e41bb720a015011efd4f63.png]
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is :-

From the given three different cubes taking figure 1 and figure 2 ,the adjacent sides are as shown below :

As 4 is common on both figure 1 and figure 2, it is clear that 1, 3, 5 and 6 are adjacent to it and remaining number i.e., 2 will be opposite to it.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/46e9a7eac56bddfe588f80ebe3c58ab6b3ff70ea7b2b47f79409b1d84ad8bbb2.png] 

Opposite pairs:

1 → 6

2 → 4

3 → 5

So, the opposite side of "2" will be side "4".

Hence, the correct answer is "4".
